blurb: Selina Dance Studio offers dance classes in various styles including Ballet, Jazz Funk, Tap, Hip Hop, Acro, Contemporary/Lyrical, and Parent-and-Me for tots. They also provide Musical Theatre classes combining singing, dancing, and acting, culminating in a final production. Camps include dance instruction, games, activities, crafts, and a Friday open house performance.
